main_text.p: Teftimoniis & iudiciis aliorū.lib.3.epist. 6.lib.5.epist.5.7. effectu & occasione malevolorum data calumniis.lib. 3. epist.6. inutili seu supervacuo. lib.7. epist.23. postrema,conclusio abfoluatur: aut [illegible, ~5 letters] adhortatione,ne hoc iterum faciat amicus.li.16.epist.25. inimicus quàm amicus esse malit.lib.5.epist.5.aut ἀξιώσει[?] petitione, ut quod neglectum compéfet amicus, vel,quod perperam factum, corrigat. lib. 3.epist. 6. lib. 5. epist. 7. lib. 7. epist.23.Aut ἀπειλὴ[?] comminatione.lib.5.epist.1. 5. Aut accusationis & expostulationis mitigatione,& [illegible, ~6 letters] delatione officij.lib. 3. epist.6. Reperiuntur verò eiusce modi ex-Materiæ expostulationum. postulationum materię Ciceronis in epistolis familiaribus variæ. Expostulationes de negligentia in scribendo.lib. 16.epist.25.cògreffu vitato.lib.3.epist.16.A' [illegible, ~6 letters] non relata gratia.lib.5. epist. 5. intermissa noftra commendatione atq; promotione.lib.5.epist.7.Neglecto precio ac delectu in emptione rerum.lib.7.epist.23.du riuscule tractatis & oppugnatis amicis. lib.5. epist. 1. In epistolis quoq; ad Atticū huius generis exempla esse poterunt.lib. 3.epist.25.in qua Cicero leniter cum Atticō expostulat, quod eo maxime tempore

page.notes: The Greek words are printed very small and I could not read them with certainty; the bracketed ones are marked illegible or [?]. The running head and the text were read from the scan with u/v normalised. The page number is printed as 22ı, i.e. 221. The margin note is printed across three lines (Materiæ ex- / postulatio- / num.) and is given here as one note.
